Nothing Phone 4b Launched in India with 6000mAh Battery

The Nothing Phone 4b has been launched in India, featuring a 6000mAh battery and the signature Glyph Bar interface. Early reports suggest the device aims to offer a compelling feature set while potentially being more affordable. The phone's design and battery capacity are highlighted as key differentiating factors in the Indian market.
